title: 韩国散户狂热：AI芯片股暴涨背后的警示
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: South Korea may have an ant problem, although it's not these type of ants, but rather these.
segments.zh: 韩国可能有个蚂蚁问题，不过不是这种蚂蚁，而是这些。

segments.en: There are more than 14 million return investors in South Korea who are called ants.
segments.zh: 韩国有超过1400万散户市场参与者，被称为蚂蚁。

segments.en: Individually, they don't have much power, but collectively they have a greater influence in the market.
segments.zh: 单个看，它们力量不大，但合起来对市场影响很大。

segments.en: These ants have been busy. Not by more than 100% so far this year, just an unbelievable rally.
segments.zh: 这些蚂蚁很忙。今年涨幅超过100%，涨势惊人。

segments.en: It's really quite extraordinary what's happening in Korean stocks at the moment.
segments.zh: 韩国市场目前的表现确实非同寻常。

segments.en: The KOSPI index, which tracks Korea's public companies, climbed 200% over the last 12 months.
segments.zh: 追踪韩国上市公司的KOSPI指数过去12个月上涨了200%。

segments.en: Compare that to other major markets, like the S&P or even the NASDAQ, and Korea's performance blows them out of the water.
segments.zh: 与其他主要市场如标普或纳斯达克相比，韩国表现遥遥领先。

segments.en: That means it has more than tripled over the past 12 months retail investors.
segments.zh: 这意味着过去12个月散户市场参与者的收益翻了三倍多。

segments.en: They've been the main driver of the KOSPI.
We can see signs of being a little bit maniac and a lot of people borrowing money to invest in stocks.
segments.zh: 我们看到一些狂热迹象，很多人借钱**权益资产。

segments.en: And amid the maniac is a mounting fear that a bubble will soon burst.
segments.zh: 狂热之中，越来越多的人担心泡沫即将破裂。

segments.en: The AI bubble debate is absolutely raging right now.
segments.zh: 关于AI泡沫的争论目前非常激烈。

segments.en: South Korea is one of the biggest beneficiaries of the global AI trade because it has two of the world's largest memory chip makers.
segments.zh: 韩国是全球AI热潮的主要受益者之一，因为它拥有两家全球最大的存储芯片制造商。

segments.en: Korean stocks are really maximizing being beneficiaries of the AI capex bubble.
segments.zh: 韩国市场正充分利用AI资本支出热潮带来的机遇。
